official_source_internal_inconsistencies.statement: README.pdf page 1 embeds two different feature tables. The 47-row table describes TCP/UDP as per-flow protocol indicators ('Indicates if the transport layer protocol is TCP/UDP') and ICMP as the network-layer indicator; the 39-row table describes TCP/UDP/ICMP as window aggregates ('Average no. of TCP/UDP/ICMP packets in the window'). Both descriptions attach to the same-named columns of the released CSV; the official documentation does not state which table corresponds to the released 39-column header.
official_source_internal_inconsistencies.consequence: Gate 7 (official documentation supports the mapping) is NOT satisfiable for any CICIoT2023 protocol-column mapping this version: the official source contradicts itself on the columns' semantics, and the released-CSV correspondence of either table is undocumented. This inconsistency is recorded here and in registry.json; no correspondence is invented to resolve it.

string_target_wording.exact_target: semantic_disposition=unresolved, decision_status=proposed; REVISED 2026-09-05 (#23 Rev 1) after independent review F23-01: dataset-native is the mainline this version and NOTHING is admitted to the pairwise core - the core stays EMPTY. tcp and udp remain CANDIDATES for a future evidence-complete review (both sides' official docs describe transport-layer protocol semantics for them, and the observed TON-IoT proto value set is tcp 168747 / udp 42015 / icmp 281 per proto census v1+v2), but the admission claim is WITHDRAWN: the official CICIoT2023 page-1 documentation is internally inconsistent about the protocol columns (47-row indicator-style table vs 39-row 'Average no. of ... packets in the window' table), so gates 3, 4, and 7 are unconfirmed for the released CSV; 'per-record aggregation' and 'whole-record window' phrasing is container language, not a definition of the measured object. icmp likewise stays unresolved: the earlier transport-vs-network-layer wording difference is NOT a proven semantic incompatibility (Zeek conn logs cover TCP/UDP/ICMP in one record type); the correct statement is that current evidence is insufficient for admission, not that incompatibility is proven. Evidence: datasets/incoming/ton_iot/Network Features-Description.pdf p.1 row 6; datasets/incoming/ciciot2023/README.pdf p.1 47-row table rows 28/29/32 and 39-row table rows 23/24/27 (archived PNGs in references/dataset_docs/ciciot2023/readme_p1_feature_table/). The remaining CICIoT2023 protocol columns (DHCP/ARP/IGMP/IPv/LLC and the application-layer set) still have no proposed TON-IoT counterpart; no correspondence is invented and no unknown value is interpreted as all-zero indicators. Excluding ICMP from cross-dataset MAPPING does not delete the 281 ICMP samples or the native proto feature.
